reviews.text: I'm a customer from the Bronx. I've been calling for three months, from 7:56 to 9:00, and I keep getting the same recording saying the slots are full. My dog ​​has a persistent cough, and this morning he woke up unable to walk on his back leg. You're the only ones I know, and I don't have the money to take Peewee Saunders anywhere else. I feel like he's dying, and I can't do anything. Please help me. How can you ask for donations if your team in New York doesn't work with such a large organization and has so many celebrities in the ads, and they don't even attend to the customers in New York? Thank you.

The appointment process at this ASPCA location really needs to be more organized and communicated clearly. I first called to make an appointment because the information online says to call. When I called, I was told that I actually needed to come in person on Monday, Wednesday, or Friday to schedule an appointment.

When I went there in person, I was then told something completely different — that appointments for vaccines, spay/neuter, etc. are made on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and that you need to arrive before 8:30 AM. I was also told that even if you come early, an appointment is not guaranteed.

So I came back and got in line before 8:30 AM, only for everyone waiting to be told that there were only TWO appointment spots available for the next two weeks because they schedule two weeks in advance and only have one doctor working.

I understand that they may have limited staff and appointment availability, but the process needs much better organization and communication. People are taking time out of their day and making multiple trips based on the instructions they are given, only to arrive and be told something completely different. If there are only a couple of appointments available, that should be made clear beforehand instead of having people come in early and wait with almost no chance of getting an appointment.

I was truly impressed by how clean, professional, and well-organized everything was. The kindness, patience, and dedication shown by your entire team did not go unnoticed. It is clear that you genuinely care about the animals and the families who love them.

Thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for everything you do and for the outstanding job you did caring for my pets. I am beyond grateful for your support and for the difference you make every single day.

My parents have a puppy named Gucci. She's very affectionate and sweet. Unfortunately; she had an accident with my parents' electric couch. Gucci suffered a deep wound on her neck. I took her to several clinics and hospitals, but they all wanted a lot of money for the surgery, money that my parents didn't have at the moment. I went to a hospital on Fordham Road, and the staff were very kind but the doctor refused to see Gucci without immediate payment or an agreement of payment. After much discussion about what I can do, she offered me to pay in 30 days. The doctor wanted $2,000 for the surgery, but I had rent, car insurance, and everything else to pay. My credit card information was stolen day before while shopping in a supermarket, so I didn't had that amount of money. The doctor just wanted money; she didn't care about the animals. A nurse was concerned and sad about Gucci and told me about this place and recommended it because of the situation and good service. I went to this hospital ASPCA and explained the situation, and from the moment we walked in; everyone treated Gucci with so much love and kindness. Gucci was very stressed in the other locations, but she felt much calmer and protected here. I wish Gucci could continue receiving treatment here but unfortunately my parents’s zip code don’t qualify. ☹️😔 Thank you all for your service and all the love. The staff and doctors are very kind and supportive. God bless you all.❤️❤️❤️🙏🤲🏻
